blurb: Blue Lotus Yoga Studio offers a variety of yoga and fitness classes for all levels, including indoor and seasonal outdoor classes at Annapolis Sailing School. They provide private instruction, workshops, and retreats. The studio also offers a 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training program with expert guidance and mentorship.
